objectives: ===== KEYCARD PROGRESSION =====/ObjectiveKeycards: ObjectiveKeycards, optional=False, terminal=Master Terminal
GameManager: GameFlowManager, win scene WinScene, end delay 3.0 s
notes: All values are world metres; east is +X, north is +Z. Wall planes are the median of 26 shell-collider hits per wall (13 stations at floor+1.2 and +5 m); hits more than 0.25 m from the median are listed as openings or recesses.

Gate scans use 0.02 m conservative sample intervals at floor+0.2, +1.2 and +1.8 m through 4 m depth. Only moving leaves and the explicit blocker are excluded; the visible aperture also tests shell/frame triangles and the leaves translated by their configured open slide. No transform or collider state is changed.

Terminal eyes use the saved player's CapsuleHeightStanding x CameraHeightRatio above the physical ground under the standing point; the prompt rule is KeycardInteractor's range, aim-angle and occlusion test. Reach samples are 0.25 m floor points whose eye is in range, whose 0.4 m capsule is clear and whose sightlines are clear.
Spawn warp positions repeat KeycardTerminal.WarpIn's 3 m NavMesh projection. A wave larger than the far-enough marker set reuses markers nudged 1.5 m, inside the 2 m disc.
NavMesh queries describe loaded Edit-mode data, not runtime door carving or an AI/Play-mode test (0.3 m sample tolerance). Across-gate paths describe the saved locked doors.
Zones are design reservations derived from the measured keep-outs, not scene objects. Nothing in this report authorises moving doors, terminals, markers, access machines or triggers.
